defects.title: A model without expressionRxns stops with an error unless all three weight fields are given

defects.observed: (R2025a, 2026-11-25) 'Unrecognized field name "expressionRxns".' at line 213, although lines 203-204 handle a model without expressionRxns; line 204 removes objectives containing 'GE0', which no objective name contains
defects.expected: the help lists expressionRxns among the model fields (so the input is not documented); the code's check suggests it was meant to be optional

defects.title: A model with bondsE but without bondsBF stops with an error
defects.trigger: the model above with model.expressionRxns = [1; 2; NaN] and model.bondsE = [1; 2; 3], no bondsBF; modelMultipleObjectives(model, struct('objectives', {{'unWeighted1norm'}}))
defects.observed: (R2025a, 2026-11-25) 'Unrecognized field name "bondsBF".' at line 191, which checks the length of bondsBF instead of bondsE; line 196 also uses the NaN mask of bondsBF; the bondsE weights are used by no objective
defects.expected: the help lists both fields; line 191 was evidently meant for bondsE

defects.title: The objective weightedTCBMflux stores its solution under unWeightedTCBMflux
defects.observed: (code reading, 2026-11-25) lines 333-336 assign solutions.unWeightedTCBMflux, so the documented output field weightedTCBMflux is never set and a requested unWeightedTCBMflux is overwritten; the objective is not in the help's list of supported objectives, its weights are a TODO (line 325) and it needs MOSEK
defects.expected: the solution in solutions.weightedTCBMflux, as the output list documents

defects.title: After the first failed objective, every later objective prints the error report again
defects.trigger: any objective list in which an objective fails (e.g. default objectives without MOSEK)
defects.observed: (R2025a, 2026-11-25) hasErrored (line 297) is never reset, so line 510 prints the last error report after every following objective, also after solved ones

notes: Exemptions: 285-289 dead code ('&& 0' on line 284); 316, 350, 368, 386, 405 = entropicFluxBalanceAnalysis calls with tcbmParam.solver = 'mosek' -- MOSEK is not installed (mosekopt undefined), the call throws and the throwing line is not counted; their catch blocks are covered by a model without S, solutions of the TCBM objectives are not asserted; 323-337 = skipped objective weightedTCBMflux (limitation). Placed in a new folder test/verifiedTests/dataIntegration/testDataIntegration (no test exists for files directly under src/dataIntegration; precedent src/design/optGeneFitness.m -> testDesign). LEAD DECISION: the three limitation entries could be read as error/wrong-result (the code treats expressionRxns, bondsBF and bondsE as optional; weightedTCBMflux is listed among the outputs); raising any of them quarantines this row and blocks its callers modelPredictiveCapacity and compareModelsFeatures. Callee observation (optimizeCbModel, already tested): every 2-norm call optimizeCbModel(model, 'min', 1e-6) or with a weight vector prints 'struct with no fields' and warns 'optProblem.F missing' (optimizeCbModel line 924; f2 is not set from F), e.g. on the toy model of this test with gurobi QP; results are correct. Weighted2normGE agrees with the hand value only to ~3e-5 (gurobi QP, objective flat at the 1e-6 scale), so a 1e-3 tolerance is used and documented.

defects.trigger: model = createModel({'R1'; 'R2'}, {'r1'; 'r2'}, {' -> A'; 'A -> '}); model.lb = [6; 0]; model.ub = [10; 2]; model.c = [0; 0]; [v, p, q, dv, obj] = fitExperimentalFlux(model, [NaN; NaN], [1; 1], [1; 1], [1; 1], struct('method', 'oneTwo')) (same with 'zeroOne')
defects.observed: (R2025a, 2026-11-25, gurobi) oneTwo: v = [4; 4], p = [2; 0], q = [0; 2], obj = NaN; zeroOne: v = [6; 6], p = [0; 0], q = [0; 4], obj = NaN; dv is NaN where vExp is NaN (line 394) and lines 401/403 add norm(dv, 1)
defects.expected: a finite objective value; vExp is documented as 'NaN if no info' and the fitted problem leaves those reactions out

defects.title: An infeasible cardinality fit stops with a MATLAB error instead of the function's message
defects.trigger: the model above, fitExperimentalFlux(model, [NaN; NaN], [Inf; Inf], [Inf; Inf], [1; 1], struct('method', 'zero'))
defects.observed: (R2025a, 2026-11-25, gurobi) MATLAB:nonExistentField 'Unrecognized field name "xyz".' at line 347; with method 'two' the same input ends with fitExperimentalFlux:infeasibleFit (line 384) after two retries
defects.expected: the error fitExperimentalFlux:infeasibleFit, as for method 'two'

notes: Reproduction (quarantine): model = createModel({'R1'; 'R2'}, {'r1'; 'r2'}, {' -> A'; 'A -> '}); model.lb = [6; 0]; model.ub = [10; 2]; model.c = [0; 0]; [v, p, q, dv, obj] = fitExperimentalFlux(model, [NaN; NaN], [1; 1], [1; 1], [1; 1], struct('method', 'oneTwo'))  % obj = NaN. Method 'two' and 'zero' gave hand-derivable results (two: v = [4; 4], p = [2; 0], q = [0; 2], obj = 8; with vExp = [5; 3] and bounds [0, 10]: v = [4; 4], dv = [1; -1], obj = 2). Side observation: the function switches CBT_QP_SOLVER to gurobi and restores it only when a QP solver was set before (lines 325-334).
